title: Spanning Diffusion and Flow-based Posterior Sampling via Exact Gaussian Conditioning
abstract: arXiv:2610.13812v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Flow-matching and diffusion models are increasingly used as priors for linear inverse problems, however, most methods are bespoke to one class of trajectory prior. Plug-and-play methods have been proposed, however these implicitly decorrelate the guided trajectory, resulting in broad priors that can struggle when data is sparse. This work proposes $\beta$-Flow: a general plug-and-play method indexed by a correlation parameter $\beta$ that generalises over flow, diffusion, and decorrelated priors, and a confidence parameter $\kappa$ that controls how strongly the path distribution is enforced. Each step requires only one forward evaluation of a denoising network, followed by a Gaussian conditioning step. This step is an exact Kalman update that is not dependent on network gradients. We show that many existing guided samplers can be interpreted as instances or approximations of our method, each implicitly using a different trajectory prior

translated_title: 通过精确高斯条件化统一扩散与基于流的后验采样
translated_abstract: 流匹配和扩散模型越来越多地被用作线性逆问题的先验，然而大多数方法都是针对某一类轨迹先验量身定制的。虽然已有即插即用方法被提出，但这些方法会隐式地去相关化引导轨迹，导致先验过于宽泛，在数据稀疏时表现不佳。本工作提出了 β-Flow：一种通用的即插即用方法，由相关参数 β 索引，可泛化流、扩散以及去相关先验；并由置信度参数 κ 控制路径分布被施加的强度。每一步只需要对去噪网络进行一次前向评估，随后执行一个高斯条件化步骤。该步骤是一个精确的卡尔曼更新，不依赖于网络梯度。我们证明了许多现有的引导采样器都可以被解释为我们方法的实例或近似，每种方法都隐式地使用了不同的轨迹先验。
tldr: 该论文提出 β-Flow，一种基于精确高斯条件化（卡尔曼更新）的通用即插即用后验采样框架，通过相关参数 β 和置信度参数 κ 统一了流匹配、扩散及去相关先验等多种现有引导采样方法。
en_tdlr: β-Flow is a general plug-and-play posterior sampling framework based on exact Gaussian conditioning (Kalman update) that unifies flow-matching, diffusion, and decorrelated trajectory priors through a correlation parameter β and a confidence parameter κ.
